decision.title: + (Deluxe)
tracklist: You Need Me, I Don't Need You

rationale: Discography populator: full tracklist (16 tracks) per https://eil.com/shop/moreinfo.asp?catalogid=617229%0D%0A, https://www.herbmusic.net/album/ed-sheeran-%2b-33303. 16 tracks = 12 standard + 4 deluxe bonus tracks. CORRECTED bonus list: the suggested 'Let It Out' is NOT on the + deluxe — every source (eil.com, HerbMusic, onlineradiobox, Last.fm, vinylkitchen, edsheeran.fandom.com) agrees the 4 bonus tracks are Autumn Leaves, Little Bird, Gold Rush, Sunburn. Note: the standard 12th track 'Give Me Love' is followed on the physical disc by the hidden track 'The Parting Glass'; the deluxe bonus tracks follow after. Japanese and Australian deluxe variants add extra bonus content (not included here).
